cn-beijing.places: Forbidden City, Tiananmen Square, Badaling Great Wall, Mutianyu Great Wall, Summer Palace, Temple of Heaven, Fragrant Hills, Shichahai, 798 Art District
cn-beijing.summary: Best: Apr–May for spring flowers, Sep–Oct for clear, crisp autumn
cn-beijing.climate: Temperate monsoon climate with four clear seasons. Spring is short, windy and dusty; summer is hot, with thunderstorms mostly in Jul–Aug; autumn is clear and dry, the most pleasant; winter is cold and dry, January about -9 to 2°C.
notes: About -9 to 2°C, bitterly cold and dry, few visitors; ice skating at Shichahai and the Summer Palace
About -6 to 5°C, still cold and windy; lively Chinese New Year temple fairs (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
About 0 to 13°C, warming up but windy and dusty; magnolia and wild peach start to bloom in late Mar
About 8 to 21°C, peach, crabapple and cherry blossoms in full bloom; some dust and willow and poplar fluff
About 14 to 27°C, sunny and comfortable; top sights very crowded over the May Day holiday
About 19 to 31°C, getting hot, fewer visitors; evenings are good for walking the hutongs
About 22 to 31°C, muggy, frequent thunderstorms; lotus in bloom, crowded in the summer holidays
About 21 to 30°C, still muggy and rainy; peak of summer family trips
About 15 to 26°C, clear and crisp, one of the most comfortable months of the year
About 7 to 19°C, very crowded over National Day; from late Oct, red leaves at Fragrant Hills and ginkgos turning yellow
About 0 to 10°C, red leaves and ginkgos at their best in early Nov; heating comes on mid-month
About -7 to 3°C, dry and cold; ice skating and skiing, sights are quiet
highlights: Cherry blossom at Yuyuantan, peach blossom on the Summer Palace West Causeway, tulips in Zhongshan Park (late Mar to Apr)
Crabapple blossom stream at the Yuan Dynasty City Wall Park, lilacs at Fayuan Temple
Lotus at the Old Summer Palace, Beihai and the Summer Palace (best in Jul)
Red leaves at Fragrant Hills (about late Oct to early Nov)
Ginkgo avenue outside Diaoyutai State Guesthouse, ginkgos at Ditan Park (about late Oct to early Nov)
Skating on natural ice at Shichahai and the Summer Palace; skiing in Yanqing, Huairou and nearby
Chinese New Year temple fairs and lantern shows in the big parks (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
cn-beijing.avoid: Over Chinese New Year, May Day and National Day Golden Week, the Forbidden City, Great Wall, Summer Palace and other sights are packed and tickets book out early. Jul–Aug is muggy with heavy storms; watch for dust and willow and poplar fluff in Mar–May.
cn-beijing.tips: The Forbidden City, National Museum and others need real-name booking ahead on official channels, often full days ahead in peak season; the Forbidden City is closed on Mondays. For the Great Wall, try the less crowded Mutianyu; Simatai night visits need booking. Wear a down jacket outdoors in winter; indoor heating is strong, so dress in layers. In spring, bring a mask if you have allergies.

cn-tianjin.places: Five Great Avenues, Italian Style Town, Tianjin Eye, Ancient Culture Street, Haihe River, Porcelain House, National Maritime Museum, Panshan Mountain in Jizhou, Huangyaguan Great Wall
cn-tianjin.summary: Best: Apr–May and Sep–Oct, mild weather for walking around
cn-tianjin.climate: Temperate monsoon climate, close to Beijing's but softened a little by the Bohai Sea. Summer is hot, humid and stormy, July averages about 27°C; winter is cold and dry, January averages about -4°C; spring and autumn are short and pleasant.
notes: About -8 to 2°C, cold and dry, parts of the Haihe River freeze, sights are quiet
About -5 to 5°C, windy and cold; Ancient Culture Street is full of Chinese New Year spirit (lunar calendar)
About 1 to 13°C, warming up but windy; peach and magnolia blossoms open in late Mar
About 9 to 21°C, crabapple on the Five Great Avenues and peach blossom at Taohua Embankment in full bloom, best for walking
About 15 to 27°C, sunny and comfortable, crowded over the May Day holiday
About 20 to 31°C, getting hot; evening Haihe River cruises and the Tianjin Eye at night are lovely
About 24 to 31°C, hot and humid, thunderstorms and heavy rain
About 23 to 30°C, muggy; escape the heat in the Jizhou hills
About 16 to 26°C, clear, crisp autumn; seafood is at its best once the Bohai fishing season opens
About 9 to 20°C, pleasant; autumn colours at Panshan and Huangyaguan in late Oct
About 1 to 11°C, getting cold; ginkgos turn gold on the Five Great Avenues in early Nov, heating comes on mid-month
About -6 to 3°C, dry and cold, low season; good for museums and crosstalk comedy shows
highlights: Crabapple blossom on the Five Great Avenues, peach blossom at Taohua Embankment (about early to mid Apr)
Bohai fishing season: mantis shrimp, swimming crab and other seafood in season (from Sep)
Autumn colours at Panshan, Jiushanding and the Huangyaguan Great Wall in Jizhou (around late Oct)
Haihe River night cruise and the Tianjin Eye lit up at night
Chinese New Year shopping and folk customs on Ancient Culture Street (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
cn-tianjin.via: High-speed train from Beijing to Tianjin, about 30 minutes
cn-tianjin.avoid: Jul–Aug is hot, humid and stormy. Over Chinese New Year, May Day, National Day Golden Week and weekends, crowds come from Beijing and there are long queues at the Five Great Avenues, Tianjin Eye and Ancient Culture Street.
cn-tianjin.tips: The Beijing–Tianjin intercity train takes about 30 minutes, good for a day or weekend trip. Go to the Tianjin Eye on a weekday evening for a shorter queue. Book ahead for popular crosstalk teahouse shows. Try jianbing guozi, guobacai and Erduoyan fried cakes at local breakfast shops; prices inside the tourist areas are higher.

cn-hebei.places: Chengde Mountain Resort, Eight Outer Temples, Bashang Grassland, Saihanba, Beidaihe, Shanhaiguan, Chongli ski resorts, Jinshanling Great Wall, Baiyangdian Lake, Zhengding Ancient Town
cn-hebei.summary: Best: Jul–Sep to escape the heat in Bashang and Chengde; Dec–Feb skiing in Chongli is second best
cn-hebei.climate: Temperate monsoon climate, very different north and south. The southern plain is hot in summer and cold in winter; the Bashang Plateau is about 1,400 m up, around 22°C by day in midsummer and as low as -30°C in winter; Beidaihe and other coastal areas are cool in summer.
notes: Chongli about -20 to -8°C, best snow; southern plain about -6 to 3°C, often smoggy
Chongli about -17 to -6°C, still very cold, ski season goes on; ski resorts busy over Chinese New Year
South warms to about 3 to 15°C, Bashang still frozen; Chongli ski season mostly ends in late Mar
South about 10 to 22°C, pear and peach blossoms; Bashang still bare and windy
About 15 to 27°C, Chengde comfortable, Baiyangdian reeds turn green, Bashang not fully green yet
Bashang turns green, wildflowers start to open, about 10 to 24°C; southern plain already hot
Bashang about 14 to 25°C, grassland flowers at their best; peak season at Beidaihe beach
Peak time to escape the heat in Chengde and Beidaihe, lotus in full bloom at Baiyangdian, about 20 to 30°C
Bashang about 5 to 20°C, birches and larches turn yellow mid to late Sep, big day-night temperature swings
End of Bashang autumn colours in early Oct, nights can drop below 0°C; south about 8 to 20°C
Winter in Bashang, south about 0 to 11°C, low season; Chongli ski resorts start opening
Chongli ski season in full swing, about -18 to -6°C; plain dry, cold and often smoggy
highlights: Skiing at Wanlong, Thaiwoo, Genting and other Chongli resorts (about Nov to Mar)
Flowers and cool summers on the Bashang Grassland and at Saihanba
Autumn birch forests at Bashang and Saihanba (about mid Sep to early Oct)
Beach holidays at Beidaihe and Aranya
Lotus and boat trips on Baiyangdian Lake
Chengde Mountain Resort and the Eight Outer Temples
Autumn colours and sea of clouds at the Jinshanling Great Wall
cn-hebei.via: High-speed train from Beijing: about 1 hour to Chengde, about 1 hour to Chongli (Taizicheng), about 2 hours to Beidaihe
cn-hebei.avoid: The plain is often smoggy in winter; Bashang is cold and bare in Nov–Apr. Over National Day Golden Week, crowds pack Bashang for autumn colours, Beidaihe and Chengde, and hotel prices double.
cn-hebei.tips: Bashang has big day-night temperature swings, bring a jacket even in midsummer; driving the Grassland Sky Road, keep to the speed limit and watch for cattle and sheep on the road. The Beijing–Zhangjiakou high-speed train takes about 1 hour from Beijing to Chongli Taizicheng station; book hotels early for ski-season weekends and Chinese New Year. Beidaihe rooms are tight in Jul–Aug, book early.

cn-shanxi.places: Pingyao Ancient City, Mount Wutai, Yungang Grottoes, Hanging Temple, Hukou Waterfall, Yingxian Wooden Pagoda, Jinci Temple, Qiao Family Compound, Wang Family Compound, Huangcheng Xiangfu
cn-shanxi.summary: Best: May–Jun and Sep–Oct, good for old buildings and Mount Wutai
cn-shanxi.climate: Temperate continental monsoon climate, dry with little rain and big day-night temperature swings. Winter is cold, January averages about -11°C in Datong in the north; summer is hot in the south and cool in the north; the terraces of Mount Wutai are about 3,000 m up, only 10 to 20°C in midsummer.
notes: Datong about -15 to -3°C, Taiyuan about -10 to 2°C, dry and cold; icicles at Hukou
About -7 to 5°C, Chinese New Year folk parades and lantern shows in Pingyao Ancient City (lunar calendar)
About 0 to 13°C, warming up, windy and dusty; the ice at Hukou melts in late Mar
About 7 to 20°C, big spring 'peach blossom flood' at Hukou; apricot and peach blossoms in the south
About 13 to 25°C, sunny and comfortable, Mount Wutai season begins, crowded over May Day
About 17 to 29°C, cool on Mount Wutai, comfortable for Yungang and the Hanging Temple
South about 21 to 31°C, rainy season starts; Mount Wutai about 10 to 22°C, good to escape the heat
About 20 to 29°C, many thunderstorms; Hukou in flood, high and muddy, sometimes visitor limits
About 13 to 25°C, clear and crisp, best time to see the old buildings
About 6 to 18°C, sunny and dry; Hukou flow is steady, rainbows are common; crowded over National Day
About -1 to 10°C, getting cold, winter on Mount Wutai, low season at the sights
About -8 to 3°C, dry and cold, few visitors, Hukou starts to freeze
highlights: Hukou Waterfall 'peach blossom flood', huge flow and very powerful
Hukou Waterfall in winter: icicles and frozen falls
Mount Wutai pilgrimage and cool summers, terraces about 10 to 20°C in midsummer
Autumn colours at Luya Mountain and Mount Wutai (about late Sep to early Oct)
Pingyao International Photography Festival and Pingyao International Film Festival (mostly in autumn, the date changes every year)
Chinese New Year folk parades and lantern shows in Pingyao, Taiyuan and elsewhere (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
cn-shanxi.avoid: Jul–Aug is hot with thunderstorms in the south, and Hukou may limit visitors or close during floods. Winter in the north is very cold and often smoggy. Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, Pingyao Ancient City and Mount Wutai are packed.
cn-shanxi.tips: Shanxi has many old buildings; reading up on the history or hiring a guide makes the visit richer. The terraces of Mount Wutai are about 3,000 m up, bring a jacket even in summer. Stay in a guesthouse inside Pingyao Ancient City for the atmosphere; book ahead in peak season. Hukou Waterfall sells tickets separately on the Shaanxi and Shanxi sides. Visit the Yungang Grottoes in the morning for better light.

cn-neimenggu-east.places: Hailar, Hulunbuir Grassland, Morigele River, Erguna Wetland, Shiwei, Manzhouli, Arxan, Genhe, Mordaga, Zhalantun
cn-neimenggu-east.summary: Best: Jul–Aug for grassland, mid to late Sep for autumn colours; winter ice and snow second best
cn-neimenggu-east.climate: Cold-temperate to mid-temperate continental climate. Winter is long and bitterly cold, Hailar about -32 to -20°C in January and Genhe even colder; summer is short and cool, July about 26°C by day and about 14°C at night; autumn starts in mid Sep and snow can fall in Oct.
notes: About -32 to -20°C, rime and reindeer at 'Cold Pole' Genhe and Arxan, ice and snow trips
About -28 to -15°C, still bitterly cold, ice and snow activities go on, a little busier over Chinese New Year
About -17 to -3°C, ice and snow start melting, grassland brown and dull
About -5 to 8°C, strong winds and dust, grassland not green yet, some forests closed for fire season
About 3 to 17°C, grassland turns green in late May, Xing'an azaleas bloom in Arxan
About 10 to 23°C, grassland turning green, wildflowers opening, few visitors yet
About 14 to 26°C, grassland at its greenest, flowers, cattle and sheep, most visitors
About 11 to 24°C, grassland peak season, haymaking starts mid to late Aug, mornings and evenings already cool
About 2 to 18°C, birches and larches turn gold mid to late Sep, beautiful but short autumn
About -8 to 8°C, leaves have fallen, snow possible, most sights in low season
About -22 to -10°C, winter sets in, first ice and snow, bleak scenery
About -30 to -18°C, ice and snow season begins: snowfields, the Cold Pole, reindeer
highlights: Summer scenery on the Hulunbuir Grassland, Morigele River and Erguna Wetland
Autumn colours at Erguna, Genhe, Mordaga and Arxan (about mid to late Sep, only 1–2 weeks)
Xing'an azaleas in Arxan (about mid to late May to early Jun)
Rime and the never-freezing river at Arxan, Cold Pole Village in Genhe, Aoluguya reindeer
Naadam festivals (mostly Jul–Aug, dates differ by county)
China–Russia border feel in Manzhouli, the Russian ethnic township at Shiwei
cn-neimenggu-east.avoid: Apr–May is windy, the grassland is brown and some forests are closed for fire season; bleak after mid Oct. Jul–Aug is peak season, rooms are tight in Hailar and Manzhouli. Over National Day Golden Week, Arxan still draws autumn crowds, but the colours have mostly passed their peak.
cn-neimenggu-east.tips: Hulunbuir's sights are spread out, so drive yourself or hire a car with driver; a usual loop is about 1,500 to 2,000 km. Lots of mosquitoes on the grassland in summer, bring repellent; big day-night swings, bring a jacket. In winter you need gear for -30°C; phone batteries freeze and shut off easily. Autumn colours last a very short time, check local updates before you go.

cn-neimenggu-west.places: Hohhot, Dazhao Temple, Xilamuren Grassland, Huitengxile, Xiangshawan (Singing Sand Bay) in Ordos, Mausoleum of Genghis Khan, Baotou, Alxa, Ejina desert poplar forest, Badain Jaran Desert
cn-neimenggu-west.summary: Best: Jul–Aug for grassland, late Sep to mid Oct for desert poplars and desert
cn-neimenggu-west.climate: Mid-temperate continental climate: dry, little rain, windy and very sunny, getting drier from east to west. Hohhot averages about -12°C in January; summer days are about 28°C, over 35°C in the desert; day-night swings are often more than 15°C.
notes: About -18 to -5°C, dry and cold, grassland frozen, few visitors
About -14 to 0°C, bitterly cold and windy; Mongolian folk customs at Chinese New Year
About -5 to 8°C, warming up but very windy, dust is common
About 3 to 17°C, peak time for strong winds and sandstorms, grassland not green yet
About 10 to 23°C, getting warm, comfortable for desert hiking, grassland starts turning green
About 15 to 28°C, grassland green, desert days start to get hot
About 17 to 29°C, grassland at its best, peak season at Xiangshawan and Xilamuren
About 15 to 27°C, grassland peak season, Naadam mostly now, harsh midday sun in the desert
About 9 to 22°C, Ejina poplars start turning yellow in late Sep, good time for desert hiking
About 1 to 16°C, poplars at their golden best early to mid Oct; Ejina extremely crowded over National Day
About -8 to 5°C, poplars drop their leaves, cold winds pick up, low season
About -16 to -3°C, bitterly cold, sometimes snow on the desert, few visitors
highlights: Golden autumn in the Ejina desert poplar forest (about late Sep to mid Oct)
Off-road driving and hiking in the Badain Jaran and Tengger deserts
Xilamuren and Huitengxile grasslands and Naadam (dates differ by place)
Sand sliding and camel rides at Xiangshawan, Ordos
Spring Grand Ceremony at the Mausoleum of Genghis Khan (21st day of the 3rd lunar month, the date changes every year)
cn-neimenggu-west.via: High-speed train from Beijing to Hohhot, about 2 hours
cn-neimenggu-west.avoid: Mar–May has frequent strong winds and sandstorms. Over National Day Golden Week the Ejina poplar forest is packed, room prices jump several times over and must be booked a month or two ahead. Midday in the desert is scorching in midsummer.
cn-neimenggu-west.tips: Cross the desert only with a licensed guide or convoy, carry plenty of water, and protect yourself from sun and sand. Ejina is far from Hohhot; fly or take the train. To avoid National Day, go in late Sep or mid Oct. Mornings and evenings on the grassland are cool, bring a jacket even in midsummer.

cn-liaoning.places: Dalian, Jinshitan, Lushunkou, Shenyang Imperial Palace, Zhang's Mansion, Yalu River in Dandong, Fenghuang Mountain, Panjin Red Beach, Benxi Water Cave, Xingcheng Ancient City
cn-liaoning.summary: Best: May–Jun for the seaside, Sep–Oct for the Red Beach and red leaves
cn-liaoning.climate: Temperate monsoon climate, wet in the east and dry in the west. Winter is cold, Shenyang averages about -12°C in January, while Dalian, softened by the sea, is about -4°C; summer is warm and rainy, with the rainy season in Jul–Aug, cooler by the sea; autumn is clear but short.
notes: Shenyang about -17 to -6°C, Dalian about -8 to 0°C, bitterly cold; hot springs and skiing
About -12 to 0°C, still cold; strong Chinese New Year customs in Shenyang and Dandong
About -4 to 8°C, warm one day and cold the next, windy, dull scenery
About 4 to 16°C, Dalian cherry blossoms open in late Apr, still feels cool
About 11 to 22°C, cherry and locust blossom season in Dalian, comfortable weather
About 16 to 26°C, seaside warming up, not much rain, moderate crowds
About 20 to 28°C, rainy season starts, many thunderstorms, peak season on the Dalian seaside
About 21 to 28°C, warmest sea, peak swimming season, sometimes typhoons
About 15 to 25°C, clear and crisp, Panjin Red Beach at its reddest
About 7 to 18°C, maple leaves red in Benxi and Dandong early to mid Oct, crowded over National Day
About -2 to 8°C, cooling fast, heating comes on, low season
About -12 to -1°C, cold; skiing and Tanggangzi hot springs
highlights: Cherry blossom at Longwangtang, Dalian (about late Apr to early May)
Locust blossom in Dalian (about mid to late May)
Cool summers on the seaside at Jinshitan, Xinghai Bay and Bangchui Island in Dalian
Panjin Red Beach, the seepweed turns red (about late Aug to early Oct, best in Sep)
Red leaves at Guanmen Mountain in Benxi, Tianhua Mountain and Fenghuang Mountain in Dandong (about late Sep to mid Oct)
Hot springs at Tanggangzi in Anshan and Gongchangling in Liaoyang, and winter skiing
cn-liaoning.avoid: Jul–Aug is the muggy rainy season, sometimes with typhoons; inland winters are bitterly cold. Over National Day Golden Week, Panjin Red Beach and the Benxi red-leaf sights have bad traffic jams; Dalian rooms are tight in the summer holidays.
cn-liaoning.tips: Dalian has lots of seafood; choose shops with clearly marked prices. The Red Beach and red leaves have short seasons, check local nature reports before you go. For winter hot springs, try Anshan, Liaoyang or Benxi. Book popular sights like the Shenyang Imperial Palace online ahead. The sun is strong by the sea in summer, use sun protection.

cn-jilin.places: Changbai Mountain Heaven Lake, Changbai Mountain North Slope, Changbai Mountain West Slope, Rime Island in Jilin City, Songhua Lake, Yanji, Tumen, Chagan Lake, Puppet Manchukuo Palace in Changchun, Jingyuetan
cn-jilin.summary: Best: Jul–Sep for Changbai Mountain, Dec–Jan for rime, skiing and winter fishing
cn-jilin.climate: Temperate continental monsoon climate. Winter is long and cold, Changchun averages about -15°C in January, and the Changbai Mountain area is colder and snowier; summer is mild and rainy, about 10°C on the top of Changbai Mountain in midsummer; autumn is short, red leaves appear by mid to late Sep.
notes: About -21 to -10°C, rime most common, peak season for skiing and winter fishing
About -17 to -5°C, still bitterly cold, rime less common; strong Chinese New Year customs in Yanbian
About -7 to 4°C, ice and snow melting, Changbai Mountain still snowy, in-between scenery
About 2 to 15°C, warming up and windy; Korean azaleas and apricot blossoms open in Yanbian in late Apr
About 9 to 22°C, spring in full swing, still some snow high on Changbai Mountain
About 15 to 26°C, ice and snow melt on Heaven Lake, the alpine garden opens
About 18 to 28°C, alpine flowers in full bloom on Changbai Mountain, quite rainy
About 17 to 27°C, peak season to escape the heat; Heaven Lake often hidden by cloud, it takes luck
About 9 to 22°C, colourful autumn on Changbai Mountain and in Red Leaf Valley mid to late Sep
About 1 to 14°C, end of autumn colours in early Oct, snow may close roads on Changbai Mountain
About -9 to 2°C, turning to winter, sights quiet, ski resorts start opening
About -17 to -7°C, rime and ski season begins, Chagan Lake winter fishing in late Dec
highlights: Rime on Rime Island in Jilin City and along the Songhua River (best around sunrise)
Chagan Lake winter fishing (from about late Dec into Jan)
Skiing at Vanke Songhua Lake, Beidahu, Wanda Changbaishan and other resorts
Heaven Lake, the alpine garden and Changbai Waterfall on Changbai Mountain
Autumn colours on Changbai Mountain and in Jiaohe Red Leaf Valley (about mid to late Sep to early Oct)
Korean azaleas in Yanbian (about late Apr to May)
cn-jilin.avoid: Mid Oct to Nov is bleak, and Heaven Lake often closes for snow; Jul–Aug is rainy and Heaven Lake is often hidden by cloud. Over Chinese New Year, National Day Golden Week and the summer holidays, queues at the Changbai Mountain North Slope are long.
cn-jilin.tips: Whether Heaven Lake is open depends a lot on the weather; check official notices before you go and allow 2 days or more. The North and West Slopes sell tickets separately, and you must take the park shuttle bus inside. For rime, get up early, best around sunrise, and bring gear for -30°C. Book hotels in Yanji and Erdaobaihe early for Golden Week.

cn-heilongjiang.places: Harbin, Central Street, Ice and Snow World, Snow Town, Yabuli, Arctic Village in Mohe, Wudalianchi, Jingpo Lake, Yichun, Zhalong
cn-heilongjiang.summary: Best: Dec–Feb for ice and snow, Jul–Aug for cool summers and forests
cn-heilongjiang.climate: Cold-temperate to mid-temperate continental monsoon climate. Winter is long and bitterly cold, Harbin averages about -18°C in January and Mohe can fall below -40°C; summer is short and cool, July averages about 23°C; the forests turn every colour in mid to late Sep, and snow can fall in Oct.
notes: Harbin about -24 to -13°C, best time for Ice and Snow World and Snow Town, Mohe extremely cold
About -20 to -8°C, ice and snow season goes on; big crowds over Chinese New Year, Snow Town prices high
About -10 to 2°C, ice and snow melting, most ice and snow parks closed, muddy streets
About 0 to 13°C, warming up and windy, scenery still bare, low season
About 8 to 21°C, spring flowers, lilacs fill Harbin's streets
About 15 to 26°C, cool and pleasant; around the summer solstice the night sky in Mohe stays faintly light
About 18 to 28°C, peak season to escape the heat; Harbin Beer Festival and forest trips
About 16 to 26°C, still cool, Jingpo Lake waterfall at full flow
About 8 to 20°C, colourful 'five-colour mountains' in Yichun and the Greater Khingan Range mid to late Sep
About -1 to 12°C, frost in the mornings and evenings, snow possible mid to late Oct, low season
About -12 to -1°C, winter sets in, ice and snow parks being built, ski resorts start opening
About -21 to -10°C, Ice and Snow World opens mid to late Dec, Snow Town scenery takes shape
highlights: Harbin Ice and Snow World (opens about mid to late Dec, until Feb)
Harbin International Ice and Snow Festival (opens around 5 Jan)
'Mushroom snow' at Snow Town and skiing at Yabuli
Summer Solstice Festival at Arctic Village in Mohe, white nights, very rarely the northern lights
Lilac season in Harbin
Harbin International Beer Festival, cool summers on Sun Island
'Five-colour mountain' autumn colours in Yichun, Mohe and the Greater Khingan Range (about mid to late Sep)
Diaoshuilou Waterfall at Jingpo Lake in high-water season
cn-heilongjiang.avoid: In Mar–Apr the ice and snow melt, ice and snow parks close, and the scenery is muddy and dull; Oct–Nov is a between-season. Around New Year's Day and Chinese New Year Golden Week, Snow Town and Ice and Snow World are most crowded and room prices soar.
cn-heilongjiang.tips: In winter you need gear for -30°C: down jacket, snow boots, hat, gloves and heat packs; phones freeze and shut off easily. Enter Ice and Snow World in the late afternoon to see the lights. For Snow Town and Mohe over New Year's Day and Chinese New Year, book rooms 1–2 months ahead and choose places with clearly marked prices. Watch out for ticks in the forests in summer.

cn-shandong.places: Qingdao, Badaguan, Laoshan, Mount Tai, Baotu Spring in Jinan, the Three Confucian Sites in Qufu, Weihai, Yantai, Penglai Pavilion, Changdao
cn-shandong.summary: Best: May and Sep–Oct; in summer, cool seaside in Qingdao and Weihai
cn-shandong.climate: Temperate monsoon climate, with clear differences between coast and inland. Qingdao and Weihai are cool in summer and mild in winter, August averages about 25°C; Jinan is hot in summer, often over 35°C; Jul–Aug is the rainy season; winter is cold and dry, bitterly cold with rime on the top of Mount Tai.
notes: Jinan about -5 to 4°C, Qingdao about -3 to 3°C, cold and dry, rime on the top of Mount Tai
About -2 to 7°C, still cold; strong Chinese New Year customs in Qufu and Jinan (lunar calendar)
About 3 to 13°C, warming up and windy; magnolias and early cherry blossoms open in late Mar
About 9 to 20°C, Qingdao cherry blossoms in full bloom mid to late Apr, spring in full swing
About 15 to 26°C, sunny and comfortable, good time to climb Mount Tai, big May Day crowds
About 20 to 30°C, getting hot inland, comfortable on the coast, Yantai cherries in season
About 23 to 31°C, muggy rainy season, frequent sea fog in Qingdao, crowded in the summer holidays
About 23 to 30°C, peak seaside season, Qingdao Beer Festival, sometimes typhoons
About 18 to 27°C, clear and crisp, sea still warm; Confucius Culture Festival in Qufu in late Sep
About 11 to 21°C, autumn colours on Mount Tai and Laoshan, huge crowds over National Day Golden Week
About 4 to 14°C, end of the red leaves at Jinan Red Leaf Valley in early Nov, then getting cold
About -3 to 6°C, dry and cold, icicles and rime on Mount Tai, low season
highlights: Cherry blossom in Zhongshan Park, Qingdao (about mid to late Apr)
Qingdao International Beer Festival (mostly late Jul to Aug)
Seaside and beaches in Qingdao, Weihai and Yantai
Night climb up Mount Tai to see the sunrise
Qufu International Confucius Culture Festival (around late Sep)
Picking big cherries in Yantai (about late May to mid Jun)
Autumn colours at Jinan Red Leaf Valley, Mount Tai and Laoshan (about mid to late Oct to early Nov)
Winter rime and icicles on Mount Tai
cn-shandong.avoid: Jul–Aug is muggy inland, and the coast sometimes gets typhoons. Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, the Mount Tai trails and Qingdao's Badaguan are packed, and sunrise on the top of Mount Tai is extremely crowded. Seaside sights are quiet in winter.
cn-shandong.tips: For a night climb up Mount Tai, bring a headlamp and a warm coat; the top is often about 10°C colder than the bottom, and you can rent an army greatcoat. Check that Qingdao seafood prices are clearly marked and choose proper restaurants. The Three Confucian Sites in Qufu have a combined ticket. Changdao is reached by boat, which stops in strong wind; check sailings ahead.

cn-henan.places: Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, White Horse Temple, Laojun Mountain, Shaolin Temple in Dengfeng, Mount Song, Qingming Riverside Park in Kaifeng, Yuntai Mountain, Yin Ruins in Anyang, Red Flag Canal in Linzhou, Taihang Grand Canyon
cn-henan.summary: Best: Apr for Luoyang peonies, Oct for clear autumn days and red leaves
cn-henan.climate: Monsoon climate between warm-temperate and subtropical, with four clear seasons. Spring is short and windy; summer is hot and rainy, often 35°C in Jul–Aug; autumn is sunny and pleasant; winter is cold and dry, Zhengzhou averages about 0°C in January, and the mountains look lovely after snow.
notes: About -4 to 6°C, cold and dry; after snow, the Golden Summit of Laojun Mountain looks like a fairyland
About -1 to 9°C, lively Chinese New Year temple fairs and lantern shows in Kaifeng and Luoyang (lunar calendar)
About 5 to 16°C, warming up; spring flowers open one after another in Luoyang and Kaifeng in late Mar
About 11 to 22°C, Luoyang peonies in bloom, peak mid-month, huge crowds
About 17 to 28°C, getting hot, big May Day crowds; Chinese roses bloom in Zhengzhou and Nanyang
About 22 to 33°C, hot and dry, wheat harvest time, strong sun outdoors
About 24 to 32°C, muggy with heavy storms, Yuntai Mountain waterfalls at their biggest
About 23 to 31°C, still hot and humid, crowded in the summer holidays; escape the heat in the mountains
About 17 to 27°C, the heat fades, clear and crisp, the best season begins
About 11 to 22°C, sunny and comfortable; red leaves at Laojun Mountain and Yuntai Mountain in late Oct
About 4 to 15°C, end of the red leaves in early Nov; Kaifeng Chrysanthemum Festival still on
About -2 to 8°C, dry and cold, low season with few visitors; see the Longmen Grottoes lit up at night
highlights: Luoyang Peony Culture Festival (about early Apr to early May, peak bloom mid Apr)
Kaifeng Chrysanthemum Culture Festival (about mid Oct to mid Nov)
Yuntai Mountain waterfalls in high-water season
Red leaves at Laojun Mountain, Yuntai Mountain and the Taihang Grand Canyon (about late Oct to early Nov)
Snow and rime on the Golden Summit of Laojun Mountain
Chinese New Year temple fairs in Kaifeng and Luoyang, and the old temple fair in Xunxian in the first lunar month (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
cn-henan.avoid: In peony season and over May Day and National Day Golden Week, Luoyang, Shaolin Temple and Laojun Mountain are packed, and the Laojun Mountain cable car queue can take hours. Jun–Aug is hot with heavy storms; Yuntai Mountain may close for a while in heavy rain.
cn-henan.tips: Peonies bloom earlier or later each year with the weather; check bloom reports before you go. Laojun Mountain limits visitor numbers on holidays, book tickets and the cable car ahead. Shaolin Temple kung fu shows run at set times. Kaifeng is best at night; book ahead for the big evening show at Qingming Riverside Park. Chinese New Year temple fairs are crowded, watch your belongings.

cn-shaanxi.places: Xi'an City Wall, Terracotta Warriors, Big Wild Goose Pagoda, Datang Everbright City, Huaqing Palace, Mount Hua, Pagoda Hill in Yan'an, Mausoleum of the Yellow Emperor, Hanzhong rapeseed flowers, Mount Taibai
cn-shaanxi.summary: Best: Mar–Apr for Hanzhong flower fields and Xi'an spring blossoms, Oct for autumn colours
cn-shaanxi.climate: Big north–south differences: the Loess Plateau in northern Shaanxi is dry, cold in winter and cool in summer; the Guanzhong Plain is very hot in summer, Xi'an often over 35°C in July, with long spells of autumn rain; Hanzhong in southern Shaanxi is subtropical, humid and mild; the high Qinling Mountains are clearly cooler.
notes: Xi'an about -4 to 6°C, dry and cold, often smoggy; few visitors before Chinese New Year
About 0 to 10°C, huge Chinese New Year crowds at the City Wall lantern show and Datang Everbright City
About 5 to 16°C, Hanzhong rapeseed flowers in full bloom mid to late Mar, Xi'an spring flowers opening
About 11 to 23°C, cherry blossom at Qinglong Temple and peonies open, comfortable for climbing Mount Hua
About 16 to 28°C, getting hot; Terracotta Warriors and Mount Hua extremely crowded over May Day
About 21 to 33°C, hot; highs in Guanzhong often over 35°C
About 23 to 35°C, very hot with thunderstorms; escape the heat in the Qinling or on Mount Taibai
About 22 to 33°C, still hot, big summer-holiday crowds at the Terracotta Warriors
About 17 to 27°C, comfortable but long spells of autumn rain (West China autumn rains)
About 10 to 20°C, red leaves on Mount Taibai and in the Qinling, extremely crowded over National Day
About 3 to 13°C, the ginkgo turns gold at Guanyin Zen Temple, getting cold
About -2 to 7°C, dry and cold, more smog once heating starts, few visitors
highlights: Hanzhong rapeseed flower fields (about mid Mar to early Apr, in Mianxian, Yangxian and nearby)
Cherry blossom at Qinglong Temple, Xi'an (about late Mar to early Apr)
Red leaves on Mount Taibai and in the Qinling (about late Sep to mid Oct)
Thousand-year-old ginkgo at Guanyin Zen Temple, Zhongnan Mountain (about late Oct to mid Nov)
Xi'an City Wall New Year lantern show (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
Climbing Mount Hua, with a night climb for the sunrise
Escaping the heat in the Qinling and on Mount Taibai
cn-shaanxi.avoid: Jun–Aug is very hot in Guanzhong, with strong sun at the Terracotta Warriors and on the City Wall. Over Chinese New Year, May Day and National Day Golden Week, the Terracotta Warriors, Mount Hua and Datang Everbright City are packed. Winter smog in Xi'an is heavy.
cn-shaanxi.tips: The Terracotta Warriors and Shaanxi History Museum need real-name booking ahead on official channels; museum tickets are often very hard to get. On Mount Hua you can take the West Peak or North Peak cable car; take care on the steep paths, and bring a headlamp and warm clothes for a night climb. Bring rain gear in Sep for the autumn rain. The Muslim Quarter is busy with tourists and pricey; locals prefer the snacks around Sajinqiao.

cn-gansu-hexi.places: Mogao Caves in Dunhuang, Singing Sand Mountain and Crescent Lake, Yadan Devil City, Yangguan Pass, Yumen Pass, Jiayuguan Pass, Zhangye Rainbow Danxia, Mati Temple, Jinta desert poplar forest, Leitai Han Tomb in Wuwei
cn-gansu-hexi.summary: Best: May–Jun and Sep–Oct, avoiding the midsummer heat and the bitter winter cold
cn-gansu-hexi.climate: Temperate continental arid climate: very little rain, strong sun, big day-night swings. In Dunhuang midsummer days are often around 35°C and nights about 20°C; winter is cold and dry, January averages about -9°C; spring brings many strong winds and dust.
notes: Dunhuang about -15 to -1°C, dry and cold; few visitors at the Mogao Caves, so you can take your time
About -10 to 5°C, cold and dry; sights fairly quiet over Chinese New Year
About -2 to 13°C, warming up and windy, more dusty days
About 5 to 21°C, strong spring winds, sometimes sandstorms; apricot and pear blossoms in the Hexi area
About 11 to 27°C, sunny and comfortable, desert sights getting busy
About 16 to 31°C, long sunny days, bright Danxia colours, more visitors
About 19 to 33°C, hot at midday; Danxia brightest after rain, crowded in the summer holidays
About 17 to 31°C, summer-holiday peak, Mogao Caves tickets hard to get, harsh midday sun
About 10 to 25°C, clear and crisp; Dunhuang grapes, melons and other fruit in season
About 2 to 18°C, Jinta poplars golden early to mid Oct, cool mornings and evenings, crowded over National Day
About -6 to 9°C, turning cold, low season, big day-night swings
About -12 to 2°C, bitterly cold and dry, sights quiet, Mogao Caves easier to book
highlights: Sunset at Zhangye Rainbow Danxia (colours brightest after rain)
Golden autumn at the Jinta desert poplar forest, Jiuquan (about early to mid Oct)
Camel rides, sand sliding and desert stars at Singing Sand Mountain and Crescent Lake
Sunset at Yadan Devil City: in summer the sun sets only after about 9 pm, so go in the late afternoon
Dunhuang fruit season: Li Guang apricots (about Jul), grapes and melons (Aug–Sep)
cn-gansu-hexi.via: High-speed train from Lanzhou: about 2 hours to Zhangye, about 3.5 hours to Jiayuguan; for Dunhuang most people fly on from there
cn-gansu-hexi.avoid: Jul–Aug is the summer-holiday peak: Mogao Caves tickets are hard to get, hotel prices double and the desert is scorching at midday. Mar–Apr is dusty. Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, Dunhuang and Zhangye have the biggest crowds.
cn-gansu-hexi.tips: The Mogao Caves use online real-name booking with visitor limits; in peak season book weeks ahead. Hexi sights are hundreds of km apart; take the high-speed train, fly, or do a big loop by hired car or self-drive. The sun is strong: use sun protection, drink plenty of water, and bring a jacket for cool desert mornings and evenings. Sunset is late here, so visit the Danxia and Singing Sand Mountain in the late afternoon.

cn-gansu-gannan.places: Labrang Monastery in Xiahe, Sangke Grassland, Zhagana, Langmusi, Gahai Lake, Zecha Stone Forest, First Bend of the Yellow River at Maqu, Luqu, Yeliguan, Milarepa Tower in Hezuo
cn-gansu-gannan.summary: Best: Jul–Aug for grassland flowers and Tibetan culture; Sep autumn colours second best
cn-gansu-gannan.climate: Plateau continental climate, about 2,900 to 3,500 m up, with long winters and no real summer. July is about 20°C by day and about 5°C at night, chilly after rain; winter is bitterly cold, down to around -20°C in January; Jun–Sep is the rainy season, with frequent afternoon showers and hail.
notes: Xiahe about -18 to 0°C, bitterly cold and dry, monasteries quiet, roads often icy
About -14 to 3°C; around Tibetan New Year, the first-month prayer festival and Buddha unveiling at Labrang Monastery (the date changes every year)
About -8 to 8°C, still cold and windy, grassland brown
About -3 to 13°C, warming up but windy, grassland not green yet, sometimes spring snow
About 2 to 17°C, grassland starts turning green, snow still possible
About 6 to 20°C, grassland green, first wildflowers, rainy season begins
About 8 to 22°C, grassland flowers at their best, frequent afternoon showers, most visitors
About 7 to 21°C, summer beauty goes on, many folk events such as the Xianglang Festival
About 3 to 17°C, autumn colours at Zhagana and Yeliguan mid to late Sep, cold mornings and evenings
About -3 to 12°C, grassland brown, snow possible, low season after National Day
About -12 to 5°C, cold, some mountain roads icy, few visitors
About -16 to 1°C, bitterly cold, monasteries and pilgrim paths peaceful, drive with care
highlights: Great Prayer Festival at Labrang Monastery in the first month: Buddha unveiling, monk dances, butter sculpture lamps (first month of the Tibetan calendar, the date changes every year)
Grassland flowers and pastures at Sangke, Gahai and Maqu
Xianglang Festival and other summer folk events (around the 6th lunar month, the date changes every year)
Autumn colours at Zhagana and Yeliguan (about mid to late Sep to early Oct)
Hiking at Zhagana, walking the pilgrim circuit at Langmusi
Sunset at the First Bend of the Yellow River at Maqu, and the summer horse racing festival (the date changes every year)
cn-gansu-gannan.via: Drive from Lanzhou to Xiahe, about 3.5 hours
cn-gansu-gannan.avoid: Nov–Apr is bitterly cold, with brown grassland and icy mountain roads; Jul–Aug has many afternoon thunderstorms and hail. Rooms are tight during the Tibetan New Year prayer festival; Labrang Monastery and Zhagana are busy over May Day and National Day Golden Week.
cn-gansu-gannan.tips: At about 3,000 m and above, take it slowly at first and avoid hard exercise and alcohol to prevent altitude sickness. Even in midsummer bring a shell jacket and fleece, and plenty of sun protection. At monasteries walk the pilgrim circuit clockwise, don't touch ritual objects, and don't take close-up photos of monks and pilgrims; watching or photographing sky burials is forbidden. In the rainy season watch for falling rocks and landslides on mountain roads.

cn-qinghai.places: Kumbum Monastery in Xining, Qinghai Lake, Chaka Salt Lake, Emerald Lake at Da Qaidam, Zhuoer Mountain in Qilian, Menyuan rapeseed flowers, Nianbao Yuze, Kanbula, Huzhu Tu Folk Park, Delingha
cn-qinghai.summary: Best: Jul–Aug for rapeseed flowers and lakes; Jun and Sep second best, fewer people and still lovely
cn-qinghai.climate: Plateau continental climate; Xining is about 2,260 m up, Qinghai Lake about 3,200 m. Summer is cool, July about 25°C by day in Xining and about 18°C at Qinghai Lake, 5 to 10°C at night; winter is cold and dry, January averages about -8°C; UV is extremely strong.
notes: Xining about -13 to 1°C, Qinghai Lake frozen with 'blue ice', few visitors
About -10 to 4°C, cold and dry; folk events at Kumbum Monastery and Huzhu over Chinese New Year
About -4 to 10°C, windy; the ice on Qinghai Lake slowly melts from late Mar
About 1 to 16°C, windy, sometimes dust, grassland brown, dull scenery
About 6 to 20°C, warming up, still cool by Qinghai Lake, sometimes snow
About 10 to 24°C, grassland green, fewer visitors, comfortable at Chaka and Emerald Lake
About 12 to 26°C, rapeseed flowers in full bloom at Menyuan and Qinghai Lake, busiest peak season
About 11 to 25°C, end of the rapeseed flowers early to mid Aug, Qilian grassland at its best
About 6 to 20°C, fewer visitors, grassland turning yellow, autumn colours at Nianbao Yuze
About -1 to 14°C, turning cold, crowded over National Day, snow possible on high roads
About -8 to 6°C, cold, low season, sights around the lake quiet
About -12 to 2°C, bitterly cold, Qinghai Lake slowly freezes from mid to late Dec
highlights: Menyuan's vast rapeseed flower fields (about mid to late Jul)
Rapeseed flowers around Qinghai Lake (about mid Jul to early Aug)
Tour of Qinghai Lake international cycling race (mostly in Jul)
'Mirror of the sky' at Chaka Salt Lake and Emerald Lake (best on calm, sunny days)
Scenery at Zhuoer Mountain and Arou Grassland in Qilian
Hiking at Nianbao Yuze (about 4,000 m up)
Winter 'blue ice' on Qinghai Lake (about Jan–Feb)
Butter lamp festival at Kumbum Monastery on the 15th of the first lunar month (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
cn-qinghai.via: High-speed train from Lanzhou to Xining, about 1 hour
cn-qinghai.avoid: In the Jul–Aug summer holidays and National Day Golden Week, crowds fill the big loop; Chaka Salt Lake and Erlangjian on Qinghai Lake are packed, and room prices double. Mar–May is windy and dusty with brown grassland. After Oct, high roads may get snow and ice.
cn-qinghai.tips: Qinghai Lake is about 3,200 m up and passes on the big loop are over 4,000 m; watch for altitude sickness and spend the first night in Xining to adjust. UV is extremely strong in summer, bring sunglasses, sunscreen and a shell jacket. The brine at Chaka Salt Lake is very corrosive, wear shoe covers or waterproof shoes. The big loop is long; allow 6–8 days by self-drive or hired car.

cn-ningxia.places: Yinchuan, Western Xia Tombs, Zhenbeibu Western Film Studio, Helan Mountain rock art, Shapotou, Sand Lake, Shuidonggou, Liupan Mountain, 108 Stupas at Qingtongxia
cn-ningxia.summary: Best: May and Sep–Oct, for desert, the Yellow River and green oases
cn-ningxia.climate: Temperate continental climate: dry, little rain, lots of sun, big day-night swings. Yinchuan in July is about 30°C by day and about 18°C at night; winter is cold and dry, January averages about -8°C; spring is windy and dusty; Liupan Mountain in the south is wetter and cooler.
notes: Yinchuan about -15 to -1°C, dry and cold, ice on Sand Lake and the Yellow River, few visitors
About -10 to 4°C, cold; at Chinese New Year try mutton eaten by hand and watch folk parades in Yinchuan
About -3 to 12°C, warming up and windy, more dusty days
About 4 to 20°C, quite windy and dusty; apricot and pear blossoms mid to late Apr
About 11 to 25°C, sunny and comfortable, best time for Shapotou and Sand Lake
About 16 to 29°C, long sunny days, getting hot, reeds turn green at Sand Lake
About 18 to 31°C, hot at midday; escape the heat on Liupan Mountain, crowded in the summer holidays
About 17 to 29°C, still warm, cool nights, great desert stars
About 11 to 24°C, clear and crisp, grape harvest at the eastern foot of Helan Mountain
About 4 to 17°C, sunny, reeds golden at Sand Lake, crowded over National Day
About -4 to 10°C, turning cold, most sights in low season
About -12 to 1°C, dry and cold, few visitors, sights quiet
highlights: Sand sliding, camel rides and sheepskin rafts on the Yellow River at Shapotou
Birdwatching and reed beds at Sand Lake (many migrating birds in summer)
Harvest season at the wineries on the eastern foot of Helan Mountain
Cool summers on Liupan Mountain and starry camping in the Tengger Desert
Golden reeds at Sand Lake and autumn on the Yellow River
Western Xia Tombs (World Heritage Site), Helan Mountain rock art and Zhenbeibu Western Film Studio
cn-ningxia.via: High-speed train from Lanzhou: about 1.5 hours to Zhongwei (Shapotou), about 2.5 hours to Yinchuan
cn-ningxia.avoid: Mar–Apr is windy and dusty; in Jul–Aug the desert ground gets extremely hot at midday. Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, Shapotou, Zhenbeibu and the Western Xia Tombs are busy, and rooms around Zhongwei are tight.
cn-ningxia.tips: Ningxia is small; with Yinchuan as a base you can link most sights in 3–5 days, easy by self-drive or hired car. On desert trips use sun protection, bring a scarf against the sand, and protect phones and cameras from sand. In Hui Muslim areas respect food customs; don't bring non-halal food into halal restaurants.

cn-xinjiang-north.places: Urumqi, Heavenly Lake of Tianshan, Kanas, Hemu, Baihaba, Sayram Lake, Duku Highway, Koktokay, Colourful Beach, Urho Ghost City
cn-xinjiang-north.summary: Best: Jul–Aug for grasslands and lakes, mid to late Sep for Kanas autumn colours
cn-xinjiang-north.climate: Temperate continental climate. Winter is long and bitterly cold, Altay and Fuyun can fall below -30°C in January, with heavy snow; summer is cool and dry, Kanas in July about 22°C by day and about 8°C at night; autumn is short, and snow starts in the mountains in late Sep.
notes: Altay about -25 to -10°C, Hemu snow scenes like a painting; skiing at Jiangjunshan and Koktokay
About -20 to -8°C, snow season goes on, plenty of ice and snow activities, bitterly cold
About -10 to 3°C, ice and snow melting, muddy roads, in-between scenery
About 2 to 16°C, Urumqi warming up, snow still in the northern mountains
About 9 to 23°C, spring on the plains, Kanas snow melting, few visitors
About 14 to 27°C, grassland turns green; the Duku Highway usually opens in early to mid Jun
About 16 to 28°C, mountain flowers everywhere, peak season at Sayram Lake and Kanas
About 15 to 27°C, grasslands and lakes at their best, most visitors
About 7 to 20°C, Kanas, Hemu and Baihaba turn gold mid to late Sep
About -1 to 12°C, end of autumn colours in early Oct; the Duku Highway usually closes around mid Oct
About -12 to 2°C, bleak after the first snow, low season
About -20 to -8°C, snow season in full swing, Hemu snow scenes and skiing
highlights: Autumn colours at Kanas, Hemu and Baihaba (about mid Sep to early Oct)
Driving the Duku Highway (open about Jun to Oct, depending on snow)
Wildflowers in bloom at Sayram Lake (about late Jun to Jul)
Autumn colours in the Irtysh Grand Canyon at Koktokay
Skiing at Jiangjunshan in Altay and Koktokay (about Nov to Apr)
Hemu in winter: snow, rime and chimney smoke
Cool summers at the Heavenly Lake of Tianshan and Kanas Lake
cn-xinjiang-north.avoid: The Duku Highway is closed from about mid Oct to Jun. In the Kanas autumn season and National Day Golden Week the crowds are huge and rooms expensive; hotels on the big loop are tight in the Jul–Aug summer holidays. Winter is bitterly cold and needs proper gear.
cn-xinjiang-north.tips: Northern Xinjiang's sights are far apart, so you usually need a self-drive or hired car; the big loop takes about 10–15 days. Daily life in Xinjiang runs about 2 hours later than in the rest of China, and in summer it gets dark after about 10 pm. Border areas such as Baihaba need a border area permit (you can apply online); there are many security checks on the road, so carry your ID. Book Kanas rooms early in peak season.

cn-xinjiang-yili.places: Yining, Nalati Grassland, Kalajun Grassland, Zhaosu, Xiata, Turgen Apricot Valley in Xinyuan, Huocheng lavender, Guozigou Valley, Tangbula, Kurdening
cn-xinjiang-yili.summary: Best: Jun–Aug for grassland flowers, Jul for rapeseed flowers; Apr apricot blossom second best
cn-xinjiang-yili.climate: The Ili River Valley has mountains on three sides and opens to the west, so moist air from the west makes it the wettest part of Xinjiang, nicknamed the 'green south beyond the frontier'. Summer is cool, Zhaosu about 22°C by day in July; winter is cold, Yining averages about -9°C in January.
notes: Yining about -15 to -3°C, cold, deep snow in the mountains, some sights closed
About -11 to 1°C, still cold, dull scenery, few visitors
About -3 to 10°C, ice and snow melting, the valley starts to warm up
About 6 to 19°C, wild apricot blossom in full bloom at Turgen Apricot Valley early to mid Apr
About 11 to 24°C, grassland turns green, first wildflowers at Nalati and Kalajun
About 15 to 28°C, grassland flowers; Huocheng lavender in full bloom mid to late Jun
About 17 to 30°C, Zhaosu rapeseed flowers and grassland at their best, peak season crowds
About 16 to 29°C, grassland still lovely, Xiata hiking season, cooler mornings and evenings in late Aug
About 9 to 22°C, grassland turns yellow, autumn colours at Kurdening and Guozigou
About 2 to 16°C, end of autumn colours in early Oct, snow starts in the mountains
About -6 to 6°C, turning cold, low season, some sights stop running
About -12 to -1°C, cold, snow in the mountains, sights quiet
highlights: Wild apricot blossom at Turgen Apricot Valley, Xinyuan (about early to mid Apr)
Huocheng lavender (about mid Jun to early Jul)
Zhaosu rapeseed flower fields (about early to mid Jul) and the Heavenly Horse Tourism Festival (mostly in Jul)
Grassland flowers at Nalati, Kalajun and Tangbula
Hiking in the Xiata scenic area, with distant views of the Muzart Glacier
Autumn colours at Kurdening, Guozigou and Xiata (about mid Sep to early Oct)
cn-xinjiang-yili.avoid: In Nov–Mar most grassland sights are in low season or closed, with snow on mountain roads. Jun–Jul lavender and rapeseed season is peak season, with rooms tight in Nalati and Zhaosu. Over National Day Golden Week the Duku Highway and the Ili loop have traffic jams.
cn-xinjiang-yili.tips: Bloom times in Ili change each year with the weather; check local flower reports before you go. Grasslands are cool in the mornings and evenings and often rainy in the afternoon, bring a shell jacket and rain gear. Nalati and Kalajun are big, so you need the park shuttle buses. Hike Xiata with a guide, and watch for rising glacier meltwater. Some roads have many security checks, carry your ID.

cn-xinjiang-south-east.places: Kashgar Old Town, Tashkurgan on the Pamir Plateau, Karakul Lake, Baisha Lake, Hotan, Taklamakan Desert Highway, Kuqa, Flaming Mountains in Turpan, Grape Valley, Hami
cn-xinjiang-south-east.summary: Best: Sep–Oct for fruit and desert poplars, Apr for Pamir apricot blossom
cn-xinjiang-south-east.climate: Warm-temperate, extremely dry climate. Turpan is the hottest place in China, with July days often over 40°C; Kashgar and Hotan are about 33°C in summer, with a lot of floating dust and sandstorms in spring; the Pamir Plateau is over 3,000 m up, cool in summer and cold in winter; in winter the basin is about -10 to 2°C.
notes: Kashgar about -11 to 0°C, Turpan about -12 to -1°C, dry and cold with little snow, few visitors
About -7 to 6°C, dry and cold, lively bazaars, still bitterly cold on the Pamir Plateau
About 2 to 16°C, warming up; Kashgar apricot blossom opens in late Mar, more dusty days
About 9 to 23°C, apricot blossom and snowy peaks together in Tashkurgan early to mid Apr, sometimes dust
About 15 to 28°C, quite a lot of dust and sandstorms, early summer already in Turpan
About 20 to 33°C, Turpan often over 38°C; mulberries and apricots in season in Kashgar
Turpan about 30 to 42°C, very hot; cool and pleasant on the Pamir Plateau
Turpan about 26 to 38°C, grapes ripen and the drying houses smell sweet, still very hot
About 13 to 27°C, fruit everywhere, clear and crisp, best time to travel
About 5 to 20°C, desert poplars golden along the Tarim River mid to late Oct, crowded over National Day
About -2 to 11°C, end of the poplars in early Nov, cooling down, fewer visitors
About -9 to 2°C, dry and cold, bitterly cold on the Pamir Plateau, low season
highlights: Kashgar apricot blossom (about late Mar), Tashkurgan apricot blossom on the Pamir Plateau (about early to mid Apr)
Turpan grape harvest and Grape Festival (mostly late Aug)
Pamir Plateau: Muztagh Ata, Karakul Lake, Baisha Lake
Desert poplar forests along the Tarim River (around Luntai and Shaya, about mid Oct to early Nov)
Fruit season: Hami melons (Jul–Sep), Aksu apples and Korla fragrant pears (Sep–Oct)
Eid al-Fitr celebrations and meshrep music and dance gatherings in Kashgar (Islamic calendar, about 11 days earlier each year)
Eid al-Adha celebrations and meshrep music and dance gatherings in Kashgar (Islamic calendar, about 11 days earlier each year)
cn-xinjiang-south-east.avoid: Jun–Aug is very hot in Turpan, often over 40°C, not good for being outside at midday. Apr–May has a lot of dust and sandstorms; winter on the Pamir Plateau is bitterly cold. Over National Day Golden Week Kashgar Old Town and Tashkurgan are busy, and flights and hotels are expensive.
cn-xinjiang-south-east.tips: Tashkurgan averages over 3,000 m up, watch for altitude sickness. Tashkurgan and Khunjerab need a border area permit (you can apply online); there are many checkpoints on the way, so carry your ID. Southern Xinjiang is vast, best to fly and then hire a car with driver. Respect Muslim customs and dress modestly in mosques. Daily life in Xinjiang runs about 2 hours later than in the rest of China.

cn-shanghai.places: The Bund, Lujiazui, Yu Garden, Wukang Road, Xintiandi, Tianzifang, Zhujiajiao, Shanghai Disneyland
cn-shanghai.summary: Best: Apr–May and Oct–Nov, mild and comfortable spring and autumn
cn-shanghai.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate with four clear seasons. Winter is damp and cold, about 3 to 8°C; mid Jun to early Jul is the plum rain season; Jul–Aug is muggy, often over 35°C; typhoons sometimes hit in summer and autumn; spring and autumn are the most pleasant.
notes: Damp, cold and cloudy, about 5 to 8°C by day, little indoor heating, good for museums
About 6 to 10°C by day; the city is emptier around Chinese New Year, lively lantern show at Yu Garden
About 12 to 16°C by day, cherry blossom and magnolia open in late Mar, weather swings between warm and cold
About 18 to 22°C by day, best spring weather, cherry blossom and tulips in full bloom in the parks
About 23 to 26°C by day, sunny and warm; sights crowded over the May Day holiday
About 27 to 29°C by day, plum rain starts mid-month: long rainy spells, muggy and humid
Very hot after the plum rain ends in early Jul, often over 35°C by day, good for indoor museums
About 33 to 36°C by day, muggy, sometimes typhoon storms; an evening walk on the Bund is more comfortable
About 28°C by day, the heat fades, typhoons still possible
About 22 to 24°C by day, clear and crisp; huge crowds on the Bund over National Day Golden Week
About 15 to 19°C by day, plane trees and ginkgos turn yellow in late Nov, best for walking
About 8 to 12°C by day, plane trees drop their leaves, strong Christmas and New Year's Eve feel
highlights: Cherry blossom and tulips at Gucun Park and Chenshan Botanical Garden
F1 Chinese Grand Prix (the date changes every year)
Shanghai International Film Festival
Hairy crab season, Mid-Autumn Festival moon viewing
Golden plane trees and ginkgos on Wukang Road and Hengshan Road
Yu Garden New Year lantern show (lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
Christmas and New Year's Eve lights at the Bund and Xintiandi
cn-shanghai.avoid: Mid Jun to early Jul is the muggy plum rain season; Jul–Aug is very hot with the odd typhoon. Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, the Bund and Disneyland are packed.
cn-shanghai.tips: On National Day and New Year's Eve, the Bund often has crowd control and nearby metro stations may close. For Disneyland avoid weekends and holidays, and buy tickets ahead. Damp winter cold feels colder than the temperature, and indoor heating is not common; in summer, guard against the heat and carry an umbrella. Hotel prices go up during the China International Import Expo in Nov.

cn-jiangsu.places: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum in Nanjing, Confucius Temple and Qinhuai River, Humble Administrator's Garden in Suzhou, Pingjiang Road, Yuantouzhu in Wuxi, Slender West Lake in Yangzhou, Zhouzhuang, Tongli
cn-jiangsu.summary: Best: Apr and Oct–Nov, for garden flowers and autumn leaves
cn-jiangsu.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate with four clear seasons. Winter is damp and cold, about 0 to 8°C, sometimes with snow; mid Jun to early Jul is the plum rain season; midsummer is muggy, often 35°C or more; spring and autumn are mild, the best time to visit the gardens.
notes: Damp and cold, about 3 to 8°C by day, sometimes snow; the gardens are most beautiful after snow
About 5 to 10°C by day, lively Qinhuai Lantern Festival at Chinese New Year, plum blossom opens in late Feb
About 12 to 17°C by day, cherry blossom in full bloom at Yuantouzhu and Jiming Temple mid to late Mar
About 18 to 23°C by day, Yangzhou qionghua flowers and spring at Slender West Lake, the best month
About 23 to 27°C by day, sunny and warm; water towns packed over May Day
About 28°C by day, plum rain starts mid-month, long rainy spells, muggy and humid; lotus starts to bloom
Very hot after the plum rain ends, often 35°C by day; visit gardens early or late in the day
Muggy, about 33 to 36°C, sometimes rain from the edge of typhoons
About 27 to 29°C by day, the heat fades; osmanthus starts to bloom in late Sep
About 21 to 24°C by day, osmanthus in the air, hairy crabs in season; crowded over National Day
About 14 to 19°C by day, red maples at Qixia Mountain and golden ginkgos mid to late Nov
About 6 to 10°C by day, damp and cold, few visitors, gardens quiet

Cherry blossom at Yuantouzhu in Wuxi and Jiming Temple in Nanjing
Qionghua flowers and spring blossom at Slender West Lake, Yangzhou

Qinhuai Lantern Festival (Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, lunar calendar, the date changes every year)
cn-jiangsu.via: High-speed train from Shanghai to Suzhou, about 30 minutes
cn-jiangsu.avoid: Mid Jun to early Jul is the plum rain season, and Jul–Aug is muggy. Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, Zhouzhuang, the Humble Administrator's Garden and the Confucius Temple have long queues, and the water towns are packed.
cn-jiangsu.tips: Popular sights like the Humble Administrator's Garden and Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum need real-name booking ahead, with visitor limits on holidays. Stay a night in a water town to see it early in the morning and at night. High-speed trains along the Shanghai–Nanjing line make it easy to link several cities. There is no central heating indoors in winter, so dress warmly for the damp cold; in the plum rain season bring rain gear and non-slip shoes.

cn-zhejiang.places: West Lake in Hangzhou, Lingyin Temple, Longjing Village, Wuzhen, Ningbo, Mount Putuo in Zhoushan, Qiandao Lake, Yandang Mountain in Wenzhou
cn-zhejiang.summary: Best: Apr–May and Oct–Nov, when West Lake is most beautiful
cn-zhejiang.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate. Winter is damp and cold, about 2 to 10°C; mid Jun to early Jul is the plum rain season; Jul–Sep is hot and the coast is often hit by typhoons, when Zhoushan ferries may stop. Spring and autumn are mild and humid.
notes: Damp and cold, about 5 to 9°C by day; with luck, snow on the Broken Bridge; quiet winter nights in Wuzhen
About 7 to 12°C by day, around Chinese New Year; plum blossom at Chaoshan and Lingfeng in late Feb
About 13 to 18°C by day, cherry blossom at Taiziwan mid to late Mar, picking of pre-Qingming Longjing tea
About 19 to 24°C by day, West Lake in spring, tulips, tea gardens at their most beautiful
About 24 to 28°C by day, comfortable at Qiandao Lake and Yandang Mountain; crowded over May Day
About 28°C by day, plum rain starts mid-month with long rainy spells; first lotus on West Lake
Very hot after the plum rain ends, about 35°C; water fun at Qiandao Lake, typhoon season begins on the islands
About 33 to 36°C by day, frequent typhoons; ferries to Zhoushan and Mount Putuo often stop

highlights: Plum blossom at Chaoshan and Lingfeng
Cherry blossom and tulips at Taiziwan, picking West Lake Longjing tea
Guanyin's Birthday on Mount Putuo (19th day of the 2nd lunar month, the date changes every year)

cn-zhejiang.avoid: Mid Jun to early Jul is the plum rain season; in the Jul–Sep typhoon season, ferries to Zhoushan and Mount Putuo often stop. Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, West Lake and Wuzhen are extremely crowded and you can hardly move on the Broken Bridge.
cn-zhejiang.tips: The West Lake area often limits cars with out-of-town plates on holidays; take the metro or cycle. Lingyin Temple and Mount Putuo are busy with worshippers at weekends, go early. In Wuzhen, stay in Xizha for the night views. For island trips, watch typhoon warnings and keep a spare day. Winter is damp and cold with no central heating, bring warm clothes.

cn-anhui.places: Huangshan, Hongcun, Xidi, Chengkan, Tachuan, Shexian Old Town, Shitan, Mount Jiuhua, Tunxi Old Street
cn-anhui.summary: Best: Mar–Apr and Oct–Nov, rapeseed flowers, seas of clouds and autumn colours
cn-anhui.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate with strong mountain features. The top of Huangshan is about 8–10°C colder than the foot, and in winter there is often rime, ice and snow. Jun–Jul plum rains bring lots of fog; in summer the summit is cool but stormy; autumn and winter give the best chance of a sea of clouds.
notes: At the foot about 3 to 8°C; the Huangshan summit is often below zero, with rime, icicles and seas of clouds after snow
At the foot about 5 to 10°C; old villages full of Chinese New Year spirit, snow on the mountain makes paths slippery
At the foot about 12 to 17°C; rapeseed flowers in full bloom at Shitan (Shexian) and Chengkan in mid to late Mar
At the foot about 18 to 23°C; spring in the old villages, Huangshan azaleas start to open; crowded at Qingming
At the foot about 23 to 27°C, Huangshan summit about 15°C; long cable car queues over the May Day holiday
At the foot about 27°C; plum rain season, foggy and rainy, distant views often hidden

At the foot about 32°C; the summit is cool, a summer escape; many student groups in the holidays
At the foot about 27°C, clear and crisp; from late Sep more chances of seas of clouds and sunrise
At the foot about 20 to 24°C, Huangshan autumn colours begin; National Day cable car queues last hours
At the foot about 13 to 18°C; red leaves at their best in Tachuan and Hongcun, peak photo season
At the foot about 6 to 10°C; first rime on the summit, few visitors and cheap rooms
highlights: Rapeseed flowers at Shitan (Shexian) and Chengkan
Alpine azaleas on Huangshan
Dizang Buddhist festival on Mount Jiuhua (30th day of the 7th lunar month, the date changes every year)
Autumn red leaves at Tachuan, Hongcun and Lucun
Huangshan sea of clouds and sunrise (best chance in winter)

cn-anhui.via: High-speed train from Hangzhou to Huangshan North Station about 1.5 hours, from Hefei about 2 hours
cn-anhui.avoid: Over May Day and National Day Golden Week, the Huangshan cable cars and Bright Summit are packed. In the June plum rains it is often foggy with no view. In winter rain or snow the mountain paths ice up, so take care not to slip.
cn-anhui.tips: On Huangshan, stay one night at the top for the sunrise and sea of clouds; book the hotel ahead. Prices on the mountain are high, and even in summer the summit is only about 15°C at night, so bring a windproof jacket. Cable cars may stop in rain, snow or strong wind; check before you go. For photos at Hongcun and Tachuan, stay at a guesthouse in the village; the light is best early and late.

cn-jiangxi.places: Huangling, Jiangwan, Xiaoqi and Shicheng in Wuyuan, Lushan, Jingdezhen, Mount Sanqing, Mount Longhu
cn-jiangxi.summary: Best: mid to late Mar for rapeseed flowers, Oct–Nov for crop drying and red maples
cn-jiangxi.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate, humid and rainy. Apr–Jun is the main rainy season, with heavy rain; in Jul–Aug the Nanchang area is very hot, about 35°C or more, while Lushan and Mount Sanqing stay cool up top. Autumn is clear and dry; winter is damp and cold.
notes: Damp and cold, about 3 to 9°C; possible rime and snow on Lushan and Mount Sanqing

About 18 to 24°C; rapeseed flowers end in early Apr, azaleas open, more rain

About 27 to 31°C; heavy rainstorms, some sights may close for flooding

About 27 to 30°C; less rain, clear and dry

cn-jiangxi.avoid: The Apr–Jun rainy season brings heavy rain and slippery mountain paths. Over Qingming, May Day and National Day, the Huangling cable car in Wuyuan has queues of several hours. Jul–Aug is very hot around Jingdezhen and Nanchang.
cn-jiangxi.tips: Wuyuan's sights are spread out; hire a car with driver or drive yourself, and do the east and north routes separately. To see sunrise and the crop drying at Huangling, stay at a guesthouse up on the hill. The rapeseed flowers come about 1–2 weeks earlier or later each year with the weather; check flower reports before you go. The Lushan mountain road has many bends; bring medicine if you get car sick.

cn-fujian.places: Gulangyu in Xiamen, Fujian Tulou, Mount Wuyi, Xiapu mudflats, Three Lanes and Seven Alleys in Fuzhou, West Street in Quanzhou, Pingtan Island, Mount Taimu
cn-fujian.summary: Best: Apr and Oct–Nov, clear and dry with few typhoons
cn-fujian.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate; winter on the coast is mild, about 10–18°C. Mar–Jun brings spring rain and plum rains; Jul–Sep is hot with frequent typhoons, often hitting Xiamen and Pingtan. Autumn and winter are dry, the best time to travel.

cn-fujian.avoid: In the Jul–Sep typhoon season flights and ferries are often cancelled, and the islands are risky. May–Jun brings plum rains and storms. Over Chinese New Year, National Day and the summer holidays, Gulangyu ferry tickets and rooms are hard to get.
cn-fujian.tips: Gulangyu ferry tickets need your real name and should be bought ahead through official channels; visitors usually board at the Xiamen–Gulangyu Pier. The Tulou sights are spread out; stay in Nanjing County or Yongding and hire a car with driver. Bamboo rafts on Mount Wuyi's Nine-Bend Stream must be booked. In typhoon season watch the weather warnings and leave room to change flight and train tickets.

cn-hubei.places: Yellow Crane Tower, East Lake and Wuhan University in Wuhan, Enshi Grand Canyon, Enshi Tusi City, Shennongjia, Three Gorges Dam in Yichang, Three Gorges Tribe
cn-hubei.summary: Best: Mar–Apr for cherry blossoms and spring outings, Oct for crisp autumn weather
cn-hubei.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate. Wuhan summers are very hot, often 36–38°C, with plum rains and storms in Jun–Jul; winter is damp and cold, about 1–8°C. The Enshi and Shennongjia mountains are cool, and Shennongjia has snow in winter for skiing.

cn-hubei.tips: Entry to Wuhan University in cherry blossom season must be booked online ahead. The Three Gorges Dam is in Yichang; Yangtze cruises can be taken one way between Yichang and Chongqing. Shennongjia mountain roads are long, at about 1,200–3,100 m up; snow chains are needed in winter. In the Wuhan summer, guard against the heat and get around by metro and ferry.

cn-hunan.places: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Tianmen Mountain, Fenghuang Old Town, Orange Isle in Changsha, Yuelu Mountain, Mount Heng (Nanyue), Langshan, Furong Town
cn-hunan.summary: Best: Apr and Oct–Nov, misty peaks and autumn colours
cn-hunan.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate. Rain falls mostly in the Apr–Jun rainy season, when Zhangjiajie is often misty; in Jul–Aug Changsha is muggy, about 35–38°C; autumn is clear and dry. Winter is damp and cold, with rime, ice and snow often on Mount Heng and Tianmen Mountain.

cn-hunan.tips: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park tickets are good for several days; stay in Wulingyuan or near Yuanjiajie. Skip the Tianmen Mountain glass walkway if you fear heights. Bars in Fenghuang Old Town are noisy at night; for quiet, stay upstream on the Tuojiang River. When mountain roads ice up in winter, some sights close for a while.

cn-guangdong.places: Shamian Island, Chen Clan Ancestral Hall and Canton Tower in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chaozhou Old Town, Shantou Little Park, Danxia Mountain in Shaoguan, Kaiping Diaolou towers
cn-guangdong.summary: Best: Oct–Dec, cool and dry with few typhoons
cn-guangdong.climate: South subtropical monsoon climate: a long summer and no real winter. May–Jun brings heavy 'dragon boat water' rains; Jul–Sep is hot and humid with frequent typhoons; Oct to Jan is clear and dry, about 15–25°C; Feb–Mar brings very damp spells.

cn-guangdong.avoid: In the Jul–Sep typhoon season flights and trains may stop. May–Jun 'dragon boat water' storms often flood the streets. Around Chinese New Year and National Day, the Guangzhou–Shenzhen expressway and border crossings are extremely crowded.
cn-guangdong.tips: In summer it is muggy outside but the air con inside is very cold; bring a thin jacket. In damp spells clothes won't dry, so pick a room with a dehumidifier. Chaoshan food is mostly around Chaozhou Old Town and Shantou Little Park. On typhoon days schools and work may stop; watch the warning signals and cancel seaside plans.

cn-guangxi.places: Li River and Elephant Trunk Hill in Guilin, Yulong River in Yangshuo, Longji rice terraces, Huangyao Ancient Town, Detian Waterfall, Beihai Silver Beach, Weizhou Island
cn-guangxi.summary: Best: Apr and Sep–Oct, Li River scenery and golden autumn terraces
cn-guangxi.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate with plenty of rain. Apr–Aug is the rainy season, wettest in June with possible floods and a full Li River; autumn and winter are dry, with the Li River lower. The Beibu Gulf gets many typhoons in summer; its winter is mild, about 15°C.
notes: Guilin about 7 to 12°C, damp and cold; Li River at low water, Beihai about 15°C

cn-guangxi.avoid: In the Jun–Aug storm season Li River boats may stop, and mountain roads near Detian Waterfall risk landslides. Jul–Sep typhoons hit Beihai and Weizhou Island. Over National Day and Chinese New Year, Yangshuo's West Street is packed.
cn-guangxi.tips: Buy Li River bamboo raft and boat tickets ahead through official channels. At Longji, stay in Ping'an or Dazhai village and see the sunrise next morning. Use sun protection when cycling the Yulong River. Weizhou Island ferry tickets sell out fast, and boats may also stop in rough winter seas. Many mosquitoes in summer; bring repellent.

cn-hainan.places: Yalong Bay, Wuzhizhou Island, Haitang Bay and Nanshan in Sanya, Qilou Old Street in Haikou, Riyue Bay in Wanning, Fenjiezhou Island in Lingshui, Nanwan Monkey Island
cn-hainan.summary: Best: Nov–Mar, the warm, sunny dry season, a winter escape
cn-hainan.climate: Tropical monsoon maritime climate, warm all year. Nov to Apr is the dry season, with Sanya days about 25–30°C; May–Oct is the muggy rainy season, and Jul–Oct brings frequent typhoons that often cancel flights and stop boats to the islands.
notes: Sanya days about 26°C, dry and sunny; peak winter escape season, hotels pricey

cn-hainan.avoid: In the Jul–Oct typhoon season, flights and island boats are often cancelled and sea activities close. Around Chinese New Year, flights and hotels can cost several times more, and airports and highways are jammed.
cn-hainan.tips: For a Chinese New Year winter escape, book flights and hotels 2–3 months ahead. Sanya's UV is strong all year; bring sunscreen and a hat. Watch the beach warning flags and don't swim outside open areas. Island boats often stop under typhoon warnings; leave spare time before your return. For seafood, choose markets and shops with clearly marked prices.

cn-chongqing.places: Hongyadong, Jiefangbei, Ciqikou, Liziba, Yangtze River Cableway, Three Natural Bridges in Wulong, Yangtze Three Gorges cruise, Dazu Rock Carvings
cn-chongqing.summary: Best: Apr–May and Oct, mild spring and autumn; midsummer is very hot
cn-chongqing.climate: Subtropical monsoon climate, foggy with little sunshine. Summer is very hot and humid, often 38–40°C in Jul–Aug, with a dry spell of little rain; winter is grey and cold, about 6–10°C, often foggy; spring and autumn are short and mild, with more rain in May–Jun.
notes: About 6 to 10°C, grey, cold and foggy; prime hotpot season, little indoor heating

Red leaves in the Little Three Gorges, Wushan
Snow on Fairy Mountain (if it snows)
cn-chongqing.avoid: Jul–Aug is very hot, often near 40°C, hard for outdoor activities. Lots of storms in June. Over National Day and May Day Golden Weeks, Hongyadong, Liziba and the Yangtze River Cableway have queues of several hours.
cn-chongqing.tips: The mountain city is full of slopes; wear comfy shoes, and map apps often get the floor levels wrong. Hongyadong's night view is best from Qiansimen Bridge or the opposite bank. Go to the Yangtze River Cableway in the morning or evening to avoid long queues. Three Gorges cruises between Yichang and Chongqing usually take 3–4 nights; book cabins ahead in high season.

cn-sichuan-chengdu.places: Kuanzhai Alley and Jinli in Chengdu, Giant Panda Breeding Research Base, Leshan Giant Buddha, Mount Emei, Dujiangyan, Mount Qingcheng, Huanglongxi
cn-sichuan-chengdu.summary: Best: Mar–Apr and Oct–Nov, spring flowers, autumn leaves and mild weather
cn-sichuan-chengdu.climate: Subtropical humid climate, more cloud than sun, with high humidity in the basin. Winter is grey and cold, about 5–10°C, and Emei's Golden Summit often has snow; summer is muggy, about 30–34°C, with storms mostly in Jul–Aug. Spring and autumn are mild.
notes: About 5 to 9°C, grey and cold; ice, snow and rime on Emei's Golden Summit, good chance of a sea of clouds
About 7 to 12°C; Panda Base crowded over Chinese New Year, magnolias open in late Feb
About 12 to 18°C; peach blossom at Longquanyi, pear blossom and rapeseed flowers at Xinjin
About 17 to 23°C; full spring, Mount Qingcheng and Dujiangyan at their most pleasant
About 21 to 27°C; warm and comfortable, pandas more active in the morning; crowded over May Day
About 24 to 29°C; more rain and muggier, Mount Emei becomes a summer escape
About 26 to 32°C; heavy storms, watch for falling rocks in the mountains
About 26 to 32°C, muggy with thunderstorms; top of Mount Emei about 15°C, a summer escape
About 22 to 27°C; long autumn rains, weather improves in late Sep
About 17 to 22°C; clear and crisp, good for climbing Mount Emei; Panda Base packed over National Day
About 12 to 17°C; Chengdu ginkgos turn gold in late Nov, one of the loveliest times
About 6 to 11°C; last ginkgos in early Dec, then grey and cold, snow starts on Mount Emei

cn-sichuan-chengdu.avoid: Jul–Aug is muggy with heavy storms, and there is a risk of falling rocks in the mountains. The Panda Base is packed over National Day and Chinese New Year. On snowy winter days, snow chains are needed to drive up Mount Emei.
cn-sichuan-chengdu.tips: Get to the Panda Base when it opens, as pandas are most active in the morning; on holidays buy tickets ahead. Emei's Golden Summit is about 15°C colder than the foot; bring a warm jacket. The Leshan Giant Buddha walkway has long queues; a boat gives the full view. Chengdu is often grey and rainy, so bring an umbrella; when ordering you can ask for less spice.

cn-sichuan-jiuzhaigou.places: Jiuzhaigou, Five-Flower Lake, Nuorilang Falls, Long Lake, Huanglong Five-Colour Pools, Songpan Old Town, Chuanzhusi, Munigou
cn-sichuan-jiuzhaigou.summary: Best: Oct, colourful forests mirrored in the lakes; Jun–Aug, with full waters, is next best
cn-sichuan-jiuzhaigou.climate: Mountain plateau climate; the Jiuzhaigou entrance is about 2,000 m up, Huanglong about 3,100–3,600 m. Summer is cool, about 20°C, with many thunderstorms; autumn is clear; winter is cold and snowy, some lakes freeze, and Huanglong is often closed in winter.
notes: Entrance about 0 to 5°C; some lakes frozen, frozen waterfalls and snow, few visitors
About 2 to 7°C; ice and snow scenery still there, Huanglong closed most of the time
About 5 to 12°C; snow melting, scenery rather bare, low-season tickets
About 9 to 16°C; ice and snow melt, wild peach blossom and fresh green, high season begins
About 13 to 20°C; water rising, fresh green and wildflowers in the hills
About 16 to 22°C; deep blue water, full waterfalls, Huanglong azaleas in full bloom
About 18 to 24°C; crowded in the summer holidays, many thunderstorms, occasional landslides on mountain roads
About 18 to 23°C; rainy season goes on, watch for landslides, enter the valley early
About 13 to 20°C; first autumn colours in late Sep, slightly fewer visitors
About 8 to 16°C; colourful forests at their peak, stunning reflections, book ahead
About 2 to 10°C; last autumn colours in early Nov, snow begins, Huanglong may close
About -3 to 5°C; winter low season, quiet snow scenes, icy roads
highlights: Wild peach blossom and fresh spring green
Alpine azaleas at Huanglong
Nuorilang Falls and Pearl Shoal in the high-water season
Jiuzhaigou colourful forests and lake reflections
Jiuzhaigou frozen waterfalls and snow
cn-sichuan-jiuzhaigou.avoid: Over National Day Golden Week, Jiuzhaigou limits visitor numbers and must be booked many days ahead, with bad queues inside. In the Jul–Aug rainy season mountain roads may have landslides. Huanglong is often closed in winter; check before you go.
cn-sichuan-jiuzhaigou.tips: Jiuzhaigou uses real-name booking and a daily limit; high-season tickets sell out early. Inside, take the sightseeing bus to Long Lake, the farthest point, first, then work your way down. Huanglong is over 3,000 m up; watch for altitude sickness, walk slowly, don't run or jump. Big temperature swings between morning and evening; bring fleece or a down jacket.

cn-sichuan-west.places: Daocheng Yading, Seda, Xinduqiao, Mount Siguniang, Hailuogou, Garze, Litang, Danba, Bipenggou
cn-sichuan-west.summary: Best: Oct for golden autumn and snow peaks; May and late Sep are next best
cn-sichuan-west.climate: Mountain plateau climate, about 2,500–4,700 m up, with strong sun and big day-night temperature swings. Jun–Aug is the rainy season, with frequent landslides and mudslides; it turns cold from Oct, after Nov high passes often close for snow, and winter is bitterly cold.
notes: Bitter plateau cold, nights often below -10°C; Hailuogou glacier and hot springs are good in winter

Days about 13 to 18°C; alpine azaleas in full bloom, many self-drivers over May Day
Days about 15 to 20°C; rainy season starts, grasslands turn green, roads get worse
Days about 15 to 22°C; peak rainy season, frequent landslides and mudslides, roads often controlled
